Weekend House Saiko offers luxury in spacious cabins set amid Lake Saiko’s tranquil nature. Cabins A–E span 3,500㎡; F and G have their own 4,000㎡ plot. Each cabin exceeds 100㎡, ensuring guests a private, relaxing retreat.
All cabins have a wood stove, underfloor heating, and a full kitchen. On your private deck, unwind in a hammock, BBQ with lake and forest views, enjoy morning coffee to birdsong, and stargaze at night. Escape city life—the perfect place to unplug and refresh in peaceful nature.

The space
【Cabin Guide】
＜Introduction＞
Our property is a peaceful retreat surrounded by beautiful, untouched nature. We invite you to enjoy the stunning scenery, soothing sounds, and new experiences this special environment offers.
Please note, however, that our cabins may not be suitable for guests who prefer lively parties, are uncomfortable with insects, or require a television. While we maintain our cabins with great care, they are not newly built, so you may notice signs of age that come with time.

Layout:
Lot size: approx. 830㎡
1st Floor (approx. 58㎡): 2 bedrooms (1 king bed, 1 double bed, 2 single beds), bathroom with bathtub
Each bedroom has a desk and chair set, suitable for remote work.
2nd Floor (approx. 58㎡): Living, dining, kitchen, BBQ terrace with Mt. Fuji view
Loft (approx. 18㎡): 2 futon sets
Maximum capacity: 6 people (including infants sharing beds)

Amenities:

Bedrooms: linens provided

Kitchen: refrigerator, microwave, electric kettle, toaster, coffee maker, rice cooker, pots, frying pans, cooking utensils (spatula, ladle, turner, rice paddle, chopsticks, BBQ tongs, skewers, kitchen scissors, etc.), tableware for all guests (mugs, glasses, plates of various sizes, wine glasses), and basic condiments (sugar, salt)

Reservations
After booking, guests are required to provide a government-issued photo ID for the guest registry. Failure or delay in providing this may result in cancellation of your booking.

Check-in / Check-out
Check-in: from 15:00
Check-out: by 10:00
We use a self check-in / check-out system. Details will be emailed after booking—please check your registered email address.

Cancellation Policy
Full refund up to 120 hours (5 days) before arrival.

After that, cancellation fees increase the closer to check-in date.

For unavoidable cancellations due to sudden weather changes, illness, etc., we will respond on a case-by-case basis.

Access & Vehicle Requirements
We recommend coming by car. Free on-site parking is available for each cottage.

Public transport is possible (train to Kawaguchiko Station + bus), but services are limited.

Winter (Dec–Mar): snow and icy roads are possible, so winter tires or snow chains are mandatory.

Fire Safety
Smoking is strictly prohibited indoors.

BBQ grills are available, but please handle fire with extreme care, especially during dry seasons due to risk of wildfire.

For Guests with Children
Please supervise children at all times, especially near the wood stove, bathroom, stairs, and outdoor equipment.

Pets
Pets are allowed in Cabin E and F. No pets in Cabin D.

Quiet Hours (after 9:00 PM)
From 21:00 onwards, please keep noise to a minimum. Avoid loud conversations, music, firecrackers, fireworks, or any actions that may disturb others.

Waste Separation & Disposal
Please follow the waste-sorting guidelines provided in the manual.

Furniture & Tableware
After use, please return all items to their original places.

Linen & Towels
Pajamas and yukata are not provided. Bath towels and face towels are available.
Used linens can be left on the bed when checking out. No cleaning or towel exchange is provided during your stay.

Sustainability
Please conserve electricity, gas, and water to help protect the environment.

Lastly
We hope you enjoy a wonderful stay! Take this opportunity to create special memories while surrounded by the beauty of nature

Guest access
Since our facility offers each cottage as a private rental, there are no restrictions on areas you may access within your reserved unit.

Other things to note
A Tranquil Escape at Lake Saiko

Just 90 minutes from central Tokyo, Lake Saiko sits 900 meters above sea level and offers a peaceful retreat surrounded by untouched nature. With minimal commercial development, the area retains its natural beauty—on a lakeside stroll, enjoy breathtaking views of Mount Fuji, the lush Aokigahara Forest, and the lake’s cobalt-blue waters. Wildlife such as deer and Japanese serows can sometimes be seen nearby.

Lake Saiko is famous for the rediscovery of the once-extinct Kunimasu trout. To protect its rich ecosystem, motorboats are not allowed, so the calm, mirror-like waters are perfect for fishing, kayaking, or stand-up paddleboarding. The lake’s 10 km circumference also makes it great for walking, jogging, or cycling.

Nearby Highlights

Saiko Iyashi no Sato Nenba: A thatched-roof village with stunning Mount Fuji views, especially during cherry blossom season.

Natural wonders like the Narusawa Ice Cave, Fugaku Wind Cave, and the vast Aokigahara Forest.

Kawaguchiko (5 min by car) and famous photo spots like Arakurayama Sengen Park and Nishiura Street (30 min by car).

In winter, enjoy easy access to Snow Park Yeti, Fujiten Snow Resort, and Kamui Misaka Ski Resort.

From serene nature to seasonal activities, Lake Saiko is the perfect base to experience the beauty of Mount Fuji and beyond.
